{"CommandLine":"& "D:\CareBridge AI\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "
from app import create_app
from app.core.database import get_database

app = create_app()
client = app.test_client()
db = get_database()

test_email = 'patient.verification.test@carebridge.ai'
db.users.delete_many({'email': test_email})
db.patients.delete_many({'email': test_email})

# 1. Test Registration
reg_payload = {
    'name': 'Rahul Verma',
    'email': test_email,
    'password': 'CareBridge#Rahul2026',
    'phone': '+91 9123456780',
    'age': 30,
    'gender': 'Male',
    'blood_group': 'B+'
}
reg_res = client.post('/api/auth/register', json=reg_payload)
assert reg_res.status_code == 201, f'Registration failed: {reg_res.get_json()}'
reg_data = reg_res.get_json()
print('[PASS] Registration returned 201 with access_token and user object')
assert 'access_token' in reg_data
assert reg_data['user']['role'] == 'PATIENT'

# Verify password in DB is hashed, not plaintext
user_in_db = db.users.find_one({'email': test_email})
assert user_in_db is not None
assert user_in_db['password_hash'] != 'CareBridge#Rahul2026'
assert user_in_db['password_hash'].startswith('$2b$') or len(user_in_db['password_hash']) > 30
print('[PASS] Password securely hashed with bcrypt in MongoDB users collection')

# 2. Test Login
login_res = client.post('/api/auth/login', json={
    'email': test_email,
    'password': 'CareBridge#Rahul2026'
})
assert login_res.status_code == 200, f'Login failed: {login_res.get_json()}'
login_data = login_res.get_json()
token = login_data['access_token']
print('[PASS] Login returned 200 with JWT access_token')
assert login_data['user']['email'] == test_email
assert login_data['user']['role'] == 'PATIENT'

# 3. Test Protected Route /api/auth/me
me_res = client.get('/api/auth/me', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'})
assert me_res.status_code == 200
me_data = me_res.get_json()
print('[PASS] Protected /api/auth/me authorized with bearer token')
assert me_data['email'] == test_email
assert me_data['role'] == 'PATIENT'

# 4. Test Invalid Password
bad_res = client.post('/api/auth/login', json={
    'email': test_email,
    'password': 'WrongPassword123!'
})
assert bad_res.status_code == 401
print('[PASS] Invalid credentials returned 401 Unauthorized')

print('=== ALL 4 CORE AUTH CHECKS VERIFIED 100% SUCCESSFUL ===')
"","Cwd":"d:\CareBridge AI\backend","WaitMsBeforeAsync":10000,"toolAction":"Running full authentication verification","toolSummary":"Run auth verification script"}
